title: Uniform local maximal-ideal power bound
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $p$ a prime ideal of $R$. Set $A=R_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $m$ its maximal ideal, and $Q$ the prime ideals $q$ of $S$ with $q\cap R=p$. For $q\in Q$, set $N_q$ equal to the maximal ideal of $S_q$ and let $\varphi_q:A\to S_q$ be the canonical localized homomorphism. There is an integer $c\geq1$ such that $N_q^c\subseteq mS_q=\operatorname{map}(\varphi_q,m)$ for every $q\in Q$. The exponent is independent of $q$.

source.place: Tag 07N9, quotient-product argument; Tags 00JA, 00CT and the cofinal-power argument in 0394

proof.text: Module-finiteness makes S integral over R. Mathlib Ideal.IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under makes each q over p minimal over pS. IsLocalization.AtPrime.radical_map_of_mem_minimalPrimes then identifies radical(pS_q) with the maximal ideal of S_q. The localRingHom commutes with the base algebra maps, so pS_q is exactly the mapped maximal ideal of R_p.

IsNoetherianRing.of_finite makes S Noetherian, and localization preserves this. Thus the maximal ideal of S_q is finitely generated. Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg gives a power contained in pS_q; replacing its exponent by max(1,n) makes it positive.

Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_primesOver gives finiteness of the primes above p directly. Choose the proved pointwise exponents, use Set.Finite.bddAbove on their finite range, and increase the resulting bound to max(1,n). Ideal.pow_le_pow_right gives the common containment. This also covers the empty fibre.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07N9 and 0394; P4 second reading uses integral incomparability and minimal-prime localization to prove the radical step directly from Mathlib.

theorem local_tensor_quotient_power_bound
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    ∃ c : ℕ, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ q : p.primesOver S,
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) ^ c ≤
        m.map (Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
          (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)))
